raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.3.1" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-rosm
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/rosm_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/rosm/rosm_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 982d404d2d318f92595d2fa08216edb66b9a475df16c72577e9416a5a1e638b6

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-curl
    - r-glue
    - r-jpeg
    - r-png
    - r-progress
    - r-rlang
    - r-wk
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-curl
    - r-glue
    - r-jpeg
    - r-png
    - r-progress
    - r-rlang
    - r-wk

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('rosm')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('rosm')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/paleolimbot/rosm
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Download and plot Open Street Map <http://www.openstreetmap.org/>, Bing Maps <http://www.bing.com/maps> and other tiled map sources. Use to create  basemaps quickly and add hillshade to vector-based maps.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - philip-khor
